purpose: Curated UAS handoff: nine primary UAS documents, assignment, evidence, diagrams and reproducibility source. Repository troubleshooting history and agent instructions are not exported.
notes: Only tracked files matching the exact paths or prefixes are selected. Explicit exclusions take precedence.
No broad docs/ or docs/uas/ prefix: future documents require an explicit selection decision.
Loose docs/*.md, docs/superpowers/, PROMPT_LANJUTAN_AGENT.md and root CLAUDE.md remain in the repository only.
Generic docs/screenshots/ PNG files are baseline UI images and remain in the repository only; they are not evidence of the latest OCR70 UI.

Visual evidence under docs/uas/evidence/ is historical, tied to its original run/source. Latest OCR70 evidence contains logs/results, without collected UI screenshots; see visual-evidence-context.json.
README/PRD links to omitted operational documents are repository references; use docs/uas/BAHAN_LAPORAN_UAS.md for the UAS evidence index.
Failed-run evidence remains included. Exclusions do not remove files from the repository.
file-manifest.json is included without a self hash; archive-metadata.json stays outside the ZIP to avoid recursive hashing.
